blocks.text: For children undergoing cancer treatment, care can extend beyond medicines and hospital procedures. Sometimes, it can also mean having the space to pick up a paintbrush, choose a color, and spend a few hours simply being a child. I.E. Medica, Inc., a leading pharmaceutical company in the Philippines, recently brought this idea to life through Art For Care, a corporate social responsibility initiative that provided pediatric cancer patients with opportunities to paint, express themselves, and enjoy creative moments away from the routines of treatment. Creating space for children to simply create Art for Care was held across three sessions: September 4 […]...
